verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const page=fs.readFileSync("app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/(profile)/calendar/page.tsx","utf8");if(page.includes("loadAdminCalendar("))fail("the public tab loads the team calendar again");if(!page.includes("adminAllowed && !adminWantsPublic")||!page.includes("redirect(teamCalendarRedirect("))fail("a Space admin opening the tab is no longer sent to the suite, and everyone else is no longer shown only the public calendar");const ws=fs.readFileSync("components/spaces/calendar-workspace.tsx","utf8");if(!ws.includes("CalendarModeToggle"))fail("no Admin / Guest toggle");if(!/adminAllowed \?[\s\S]{0,800}Guest preview/.test(ws))fail("the Admin / Guest audience switch is no longer gated on the viewer");if(!/adminAllowed && view === [\x27"]admin[\x27"][\s\S]{0,400}STAFF_CALENDAR_LAYERS/.test(ws))fail("the staff layer chips are no longer gated on the viewer, so a member could be offered the private layers");const cons=fs.readFileSync("app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/calendar/page.tsx","utf8");if(!cons.includes("loadAdminCalendar("))fail("the console and the tab do not share one loader")'
verify.note: Passes when the Calendar tab gates loadAdminCalendar on adminAllowed, the client shell gates CalendarModeToggle on the viewer, and the settings console shares the loader. Rewritten 2026-09-20 for ADR-1467. Role based (LIVE-1704): the Calendar tab shows everyone the public calendar and sends a Space admin to the suite (the console loads the team calendar); the probe checks that split.
